title: Fan Temperature Limits Ruler
description: Horizontal range chart of twelve FanPedia temperature limits on a 0-1,200°F axis with a movable temperature marker that lists the active limits, followed by five fixed multiple-choice questions (one attempt each) that move the marker to the question's temperature, highlight the deciding row and give the reason.
creator: Twin City Fan
subject: high temperature construction

educational.audience: Adult professional development: new application engineers, sales staff, representatives and facilities staff
educational.topic: Temperature limits of fan packages, materials and constructions
learningObjectives: The learner will use FanPedia's temperature limits to decide, for five stated fans and design temperatures, which package, material or construction rule applies, answering at least 4 of 5 correctly.

accessibility.notes: Chart canvas has an aria-label; the active limits are also listed in a polite live text readout; active rows carry a ✓ and bold label, the deciding row a ▶ and a heavy outline, so colour is never the only cue; the marker is a native range input with aria-valuetext; options are native buttons (keys 1-4), Enter submits and moves on; verdicts announced through FP.announce.

controls.label: Temperature marker
controls.purpose: Move the marker from 0 to 1,200°F in 10°F steps (exploration)

controls.label: Start over
controls.purpose: Reset the questions, the score and the marker

rules: A row is active when T lies in its range; 'to' ranges include both ends, 'over 275' means T > 275, 'over 300' means T > 300, open-ended rows have no upper bound.
Five questions, fixed order, one attempt each; the correct option is revealed after each answer.
Mastery is 4 of 5 on the first attempt.
assumptions: Question temperatures are illustrative design points.
limitations: Shows the chapter's twelve limits; coatings, leak-tight levels other than nominal and axial packages beyond row 3 are not drawn.

sources: FanPedia: The Fan & Blower Encyclopedia (Twin City Fan), pp. 106, 110, 111, 114, 116, 120, 192, https://tcf.com/fanpedia/

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore overlapping limits on one scale, then commit an answer per scenario and confirm it on the chart
keyQuestions: Move the marker to your job's temperature. Which limits does it cross?
Why do the aluminum limits for Arr. 4 centrifugal fans and axial impellers differ?
Which limits besides the package switch on at 320°F and at 550°F?
commonMisconceptions: One aluminum limit applies to every fan type.
A temperature exactly at a boundary belongs to the lower band in every case.
If the package fits, nothing else needs checking.
assessmentOpportunities: Running score 'Questions correct: n of 5'; mastery is 4 of 5 on the first attempt.
